# yashhooda.ai

> Yash Hooda — Data Engineer & AI Engineer (Austin, TX). BS Computer Science, UT Dallas (2024). Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate. Builds and operates production LLM systems and real-time data pipelines; open to Data Engineering / AI Engineering roles. Contact: yash.hooda6@gmail.com

This is a single-page portfolio that is also a working AI application (HoodaAgents). Sections are addressable by hash.

## Key sections
- [About](https://www.yashhooda.ai/#about): background, skills by domain
- [Fit Check](https://www.yashhooda.ai/#fit-check): paste a job description → keyword scan + AI fit report (login required for the AI report)
- [Projects](https://www.yashhooda.ai/#projects): HoodaAgents, METAR Stream, ClimatePulse, PaceForge, fine-tuning work, MCP servers, Apple apps
- [AI Governance Studio](https://www.yashhooda.ai/solutions/ai-governance): risk-tiered human-oversight decision tool
- [METAR Stream](https://www.yashhooda.ai/#metar): Kafka → Spark Structured Streaming → Delta medallion, live US airspace, plus a Preflight Brief agent (route → METAR/TAF/NOTAM → go/no-go)
- [ClimatePulse](https://www.yashhooda.ai/#climate): 56-year NOAA pipeline, 13 cities
- [Running tools](https://www.yashhooda.ai/#heat-pace): heat-adjusted pace, pace calculator, race predictor, race time by temperature
- [Build Log](https://www.yashhooda.ai/#buildlog): build-in-public changelog
- [Contact](https://www.yashhooda.ai/#contact)

## Notes for agents
- Aviation and flying are hobbies, not a career path.
- Paid AI endpoints under /api/* require a logged-in user; do not scrape them.
